justification: SELINA: I looked at a backup from Carolina and a reigning MVP sitting on my OWN bench and I did the math myself, Gary, before you could even open the binder — Bryce Young is benched, Josh Allen starts, because I am not running a quarterback who makes headlines for the wrong reasons when I've got the biggest name in football just sitting there waiting for me to notice him. GARY: for the record, the projection gap is real — 24.55 to 17.94, not close — so this is one of the rare weeks her gut and my spreadsheet actually agree, and I'm not going to be the one who points that out twice. Braelon Allen and Jaylen Waddle both carry Questionable tags, but there's no healthy name on this bench who outprojects either of them, so they stay — that's not loyalty, that's just arithmetic, and Selina's taking credit for it anyway. Metcalf holds the flex over Odunze and Shakir on the same logic. Nine of my own dollars are still sitting untouched and Kris can print that as a mystery for one more week.
forum_post: Tony, sweetheart, I hear you're big on loyalty — I'm bigger on upgrades. I benched a man with an NFL contract for a man with an MVP case, and I did it with my own two hands, no committee, no permission. 'Last in scoring' is your problem this week, not mine. Golden Child, retained, with a raise, and about to collect your family's lunch money on the way out.
